sources.title: Getting started with Classification - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Classification works by training a model on labeled data so it can learn patterns and predict the correct class for new inputs. The main steps involved are: Data Collection: Start with a dataset where each data point has a correct label. Feature Extraction: Identify important features such as color, shape or texture that help distinguish classes.
